fixes.explanation: False. The people don't refuse, they agree. Joshua says, "You are witnesses against yourselves…" and the people reply, "We are witnesses!" That's a yes to their own promise.

A lampstand is something the LORD told Moses to make of pure gold (Exodus 25:31). Here, though, Joshua takes a large stone and sets it up under the oak near the sanctuary of the LORD. Plain old stone, friend.
